findings.description: Elisabeth Myslisch married Anton Netzel on 2 February 1845 at Oxhöft, Putzig, West Prussia; the church entry indexes the bride as Elisabeth Desmer, born about 1805, and the groom as born about 1808.
supporting_sources: Deutschland, Preußen, Westpreußen, Katholische und Lutherisch Kirchenbücher, 1537-1981 — marriage entry for Anton Netzel and Elisabeth Desmer, 2 Feb 1845
